verdict.rationale: The evidence implies an app distribution channel: developers can publish agents and apps in Teams [docs-7], and teams can be configured with apps via Microsoft Graph [docs-35, docs-43]. Connectors also let users subscribe to notifications from web services [docs-30]. None of the items, however, describes a team-admin browsing an app store or directory and installing prebuilt third-party integrations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an app store/marketplace, an admin-facing install flow for prebuilt apps, a catalog of available integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
